name: Arc de Triomphe
desc: Triumphal arch honoring those who fought for France, set atop Champs-Élysées.

desc_fr: Arc de triomphe honorant ceux qui ont combattu pour la France, situé au sommet des Champs-Élysées.
desc_de: Triumphbogen zu Ehren derjenigen, die für Frankreich gekämpft haben, auf der Champs-Élysées.
tip: 🎟️ Access via the underground pedestrian tunnel (never attempt to cross the chaotic roundabout above ground)! Climb to the rooftop 30 minutes before sunset for breathtaking 360° views down the 12 radiating avenues and the sparkling Eiffel Tower.
desc_nl: Triumphal arch honoring those who fought for France, set atop Champs-Élysées.
insiderTip_en: 🎟️ Access via the underground pedestrian tunnel (never attempt to cross the chaotic roundabout above ground)! Climb to the rooftop 30 minutes before sunset for breathtaking 360° views down the 12 radiating avenues and the sparkling Eiffel Tower.

insiderTip_de: 🎟️ Zugang zwingend durch die Unterführung (niemals den Kreisverkehr oberirdisch überqueren)! Steigen Sie 30 Min. vor Sonnenuntergang auf die Aussichtsplattform für den besten Blick auf die 12 Alleen und den Eiffelturm.
insiderTip_es: 🎟️ Accede a través del túnel subterráneo peatonal (¡nunca intentes cruzar la rotonda a pie!). Sube a la azotea 30 minutos antes del atardecer para disfrutar de las mejores vistas hacia las 12 avenidas y la Torre Eiffel iluminada.
insiderTip_nl: 🎟️ Access via the underground pedestrian tunnel (never attempt to cross the chaotic roundabout above ground)! Climb to the rooftop 30 minutes before sunset for breathtaking 360° views down the 12 radiating avenues and the sparkling Eiffel Tower.

insiderTip_nl: 🎟️ Visit between 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM on a sunny day when sunlight floods the 1,113 13th-century stained glass windows. Mandatory timed online security ticket.

desc_nl: Neoclassical mausoleum containing tombs of Victor Hugo, Voltaire & Marie Curie.
insiderTip_en: ☀️ Visit on a sunny day between 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM when sunlight directly penetrates the 15-meter 13th-century stained glass windows upstairs.

name: Jardin du Luxembourg
desc: 60-acre park featuring Medici Fountain, tree-lined promenades and sailboat basin.
desc_en: 60-acre park featuring Medici Fountain, tree-lined promenades and sailboat basin.
desc_es: Parque de 60 acres con fuente de los Medici, paseos arbolados y embarcadero para veleros.
desc_fr: Parc de 60 ha avec fontaine Médicis, promenades bordées d'arbres et bassin pour voiliers.
desc_de: 60 Hektar großer Park mit Medici-Brunnen, von Bäumen gesäumten Promenaden und Segelbootbecken.
tip: Escalator access to the top floor offers a sweeping rooftop view over Paris including Notre-Dame and Montmartre.
de: Mit der transparenten Außen-Rolltreppe ins oberste Stockwerk fahren für den Ausblick über die Dächer von Paris.
desc_nl: 60-acre park featuring Medici Fountain, tree-lined promenades and sailboat basin.
insiderTip_en: Escalator access to the top floor offers a sweeping rooftop view over Paris including Notre-Dame and Montmartre.
insiderTip_fr: Empruntez la chenille mécanique extérieure transparente jusqu'au toit pour un super panorama sur les toits de Paris.
insiderTip_de: Die grünen Stühle rund um das Hauptbecken können frei bewegt werden. Der schattige Bereich am Medici-Brunnen lädt zum Entspannen ein.
insiderTip_es: Sube por las escaleras mecánicas tubulares transparentes hasta la última planta para disfrutar de una vista panorámica de París.
insiderTip_nl: Escalator access to the top floor offers a sweeping rooftop view over Paris including Notre-Dame and Montmartre.

name: Opéra Garnier
desc: Opulent 1,979-seat opera house featuring Chagall ceiling and grand marble staircase.
desc_en: Opulent 1,979-seat opera house featuring a breathtaking Chagall ceiling and a grand marble staircase.
desc_es: Opulenta ópera con capacidad para 1979 asientos, techo de Chagall y gran escalera de mármol.
desc_fr: Opulent opéra de 1 979 places avec plafond Chagall et grand escalier en marbre.
desc_de: Opulentes Opernhaus mit 1.979 Sitzplätzen, Chagall-Decke und großer Marmortreppe.
tip: Pull up iconic green metal chairs ('Chaises du Luxembourg') around the central Medici Fountain for a relaxing afternoon read or picnic.
de: Die grünen Metallstühle frei am Medici-Brunnen aufstellen und das entspannte Pariser Parkleben genießen.
desc_nl: Opulent 1,979-seat opera house featuring Chagall ceiling and grand marble staircase.
insiderTip_en: Search for Box 5 on the first floor—the authentic box of the Phantom of the Opera! Take time to admire the ceiling painted by Chagall.
whyThisSpot_en: A true masterpiece of 19th-century architecture that offers a dazzling glimpse into Parisian high society and inspired 'The Phantom of the Opera'.
insiderTip_fr: Déplacez librement les célèbres chaises vertes en métal autour de la fontaine Médicis pour une pause au soleil.
insiderTip_de: Suchen Sie nach Loge 5 im ersten Stock – der echten Loge des Phantoms der Oper! Bewundern Sie die von Chagall bemalte Decke im Hauptsaal.
insiderTip_es: Mueve las icónicas sillas verdes de metal cerca de la fuente Médicis para relajarte o almorzar al aire libre.
insiderTip_nl: Pull up iconic green metal chairs ('Chaises du Luxembourg') around the central Medici Fountain for a relaxing afternoon read or picnic.

name: Pont Alexandre III

insiderTip_es: 🎟️ Compra el acceso a la cúpula en verano para subir 206 escalones y ver el Barrio Latino desde las alturas.
insiderTip_nl: 🎟️ Buy the dome access option during summer months to climb 206 stairs for a rare high-altitude view of the Latin Quarter.

desc_es: Complejo con cúpulas doradas que alberga el Museo Militar de Francia y la tumba de Napoleón.
desc_fr: Musée d'art impressionniste célèbre pour les célèbres Nymphéas monumentaux de Claude Monet.
desc_de: Komplex mit goldener Kuppel, in dem sich das französische Militärmuseum und Napoleons Grab befinden.

insiderTip_es: Si vienes principalmente a ver la Tumba de Napoleón, entra por la puerta sur (Iglesia del Domo) para evitar las colas del museo militar.
insiderTip_nl: If visiting specifically for Napoleon's Tomb, enter via the South Gate (Dome Church entrance) to bypass the main military museum queues.

name: Pont des Arts
desc: Iconic pedestrian wooden bridge connecting the Louvre and Institut de France.
desc_en: Iconic pedestrian wooden bridge spanning the Seine, connecting the majestic Louvre to the historic Institut de France.

desc_fr: Pont piétonnier emblématique en bois reliant le Louvre et l'Institut de France.

name_es: Pont des Arts (Puente de las Artes)

insiderTip_fr: Bien que les cadenas d'amour aient été retirés pour sécurité, le pont reste l'un des meilleurs spots piétons pour contempler le coucher de soleil.
insiderTip_de: Obwohl die Liebesschlösser aus Sicherheitsgründen entfernt wurden, bleibt die Brücke einer der besten Orte für Sonnenuntergänge über der Seine.
insiderTip_es: Aunque los candados del amor fueron retirados por seguridad, sigue siendo uno de los mejores puentes peatonales para admirar la puesta de sol.
insiderTip_nl: While the love locks were removed for safety, it remains one of Paris's best pedestrian spots for watching the sunset over Île de la Cité.

name: Catacombes de Paris
desc: Underground ossuary holding the remains of over six million Parisians.
desc_en: A vast underground ossuary holding the remains of over six million Parisians in a labyrinth of ancient mining tunnels.
desc_es: La plaza planificada más antigua de París, rodeada de 36 pabellones de ladrillo rojo y piedra.
desc_fr: Ossuaire souterrain abritant les restes de plus de six millions de Parisiens.
desc_de: Ältester geplanter Platz von Paris im Marais-Viertel mit symmetrischen Backsteinpalästen.
tip: Constant 14°C temperature underground means a light jacket is needed year-round. The exit is several blocks away from the entrance, so do not leave luggage in lockers nearby.

insiderTip_en: A constant 14°C temperature underground means a light jacket is needed year-round. The exit is several blocks away, so do not leave luggage in nearby lockers.

insiderTip_fr: La température constante de 14°C sous terre nécessite une veste toute l'année. La sortie est distante de l'entrée.

insiderTip_nl: Constant 14°C temperature underground means a light jacket is needed year-round. The exit is several blocks away from the entrance, so do not leave luggage in lockers nearby.
